task_title: Capture the live task-state journal coherently for promotion
summary: Implemented bounded descriptor-based journal capture and revalidation for task_state_store.event_log that permits only proven append growth during capture while retaining every path, inode, prefix, permission, transaction, and runtime safety gate.

acceptance_criteria_verification.evidence: Added test_task_state_event_log_reproduction_transaction_f031441_concurrent_append proving live append growth during journal capture succeeds without changing identity baseline or throwing changed during capture.

acceptance_criteria_verification.criterion: Diagnose precise contract needed for task_state_store.event_log
acceptance_criteria_verification.evidence: task_state_store.event_log is explicitly handled via capture_append_only_journal while keeping path, parent directory, mode, single-link, device/inode identity, writable checks, and outside-command-runtime boundary fail closed.

acceptance_criteria_verification.criterion: Implement bounded descriptor-based journal capture and revalidation
acceptance_criteria_verification.evidence: Implemented OSLaunchFilesystem.capture_append_only_journal using descriptor-bound stat comparisons and chunked _hash_descriptor_range to verify initial prefix hashes and permit only proven appends.

acceptance_criteria_verification.criterion: Do not weaken OSLaunchFilesystem.capture_regular_file for immutable launch sources
acceptance_criteria_verification.evidence: OSLaunchFilesystem.capture_regular_file remains unchanged for supervisor.py, ai-status.sh, ai_status.py, interpreter, live config, and is verified by test_task_state_event_log_immutable_sources_remain_fail_closed.

Added 12 focused adversarial tests covering concurrent appends, multi-append growth, empty and large journals, prefix overwrite, same-size rewrite, truncation, truncate-and-regrow, inode swap, symlinks, hardlinks, mode drift, and immutable source fail-closed behavior.

acceptance_criteria_verification.criterion: Run complete promotion suite and commit task-scoped evidence manifest

acceptance_criteria_verification.evidence: No live config, runtime state, or running processes were mutated.
